_why: cs #383·AI. After the C0108 re-cut, seed 108 no longer teaches 'نبودیم' (we weren't); its LEGO is now 'انتظار نداشتیم' (we didn't expect). Eight rows in seeds 109-111 said 'we weren't ...' and fail vocabulary. Six are re-said in the positive with 'بودیم' (we were, taught S0107L02) and words they already used: 'آماده بودیم' = we were ready, 'مطمئن بودیم' = we were sure (Aryanpur Persian-English Dictionary: بودن 'to be', آماده 'ready', مطمئن 'sure'). Re-saying them with 'انتظار نداشتیم' cannot pass the builder (each seed is validated without the 108 overlay, and no other LEGO teaches it). Two rows are deleted (thin basket over a bad row, Kai 19 Nov): S0110L02U04 and U05 ('after we learn/work, we weren't ...', where the tense was already wrong). S0110L01U04 is kept, re-said, because that basket is at its USE minimum.
